title: Dow Jones expected to lead gains on peace-deal hopes as SpaceX prepares for take-off
title_zh: 随着 SpaceX 准备起飞，道琼斯预计将因和平协议希望而领涨
summary: 8am: US stock futures rise Wall Street is heading for a firmer open on Friday, with futures ticking higher as investors weigh President Donald Trump’s sudden shift on Iran and turn attention to a blockbuster market debut.
summary_zh: 上午 8 点：美国股指期货上涨 华尔街周五开盘走强，随着投资者权衡唐纳德·特朗普总统在伊朗问题上的突然转变，并将注意力转向重磅上市，期货走高。

title: Dow Jones Futures Rise, Oil Skids On Iran Deal Hopes; SpaceX IPO Indicated Higher
title_zh: 道琼斯期货上涨，伊朗协议希望导致油价下滑； SpaceX 首次公开募股 (IPO) 更高
summary: Futures rose and oil prices dived on Iran deal hopes, extending Thursday's big moves. The SpaceX IPO is set to begin trading.
summary_zh: 由于伊朗达成协议的希望，期货上涨，油价下跌，延续了周四的大幅走势。 SpaceX 首次公开募股 (IPO) 即将开始交易。
